title: [VIC] 2x Cheeseburgers, Small Drink & Chips for $4 @ McDonald's Ringwood/Croydon/Kilsyth/Bayswater/Boronia/Wantirna/Mooroolbark
body:
Deal: [VIC] 2x Cheeseburgers, Small Drink & Chips for $4 @ McDonald's Ringwood/Croydon/Kilsyth/Bayswater/Boronia/Wantirna/Mooroolbark

[safrane] They did the same at nearby Doveton when the first Wendy's in Dandenong opened.
[Fuzor] Offer must not be distributed or redeemed by a child under 15 years…since when did this become a thing?
Just had a look at Wendy's menu and pricing. A cheesburger is $5 from Wendy. This seems like a bit of an overreaction from Maccas
[tenpercent] They really don't want their McCustomers to find out that food-like menu items not starting with "Mc" still contains actual food ingredients at other establishments.
[safrane] I think it's more about the location that drives sales. The Dandenong store had a long busy run (albeit the first store in VIC) but Seaford is AFAIK relatively quiet by comparison. I'm assuming Maccas HQ did the maths and thought Wendy's will do well there with the Knox/Croydon crowd.
[Snoop] I'm getting the deal at The 3 Frankston stores surrounding it… including Fston Sth and Fston Nth.
[AsukaST] since when did this become a thing
it's always there.
There was a free or 50 cents big mac offer last year or so, also has this T&C.
No one cares thou.
[ProlapsedHeinous] Its not about the profits, its about starving wendys of their profits.
[CORWIN] I can’t find this in the app, do you need to be in store to order? Was looking at pick up deals. Thanks
[VantageXL] I also couldn’t find it in the app but when I went to the counter and showed them the image they instantly knew.
[shortgum] FREE https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/982837
[urbancartel] Poster made by the work experience kid - 2 at's in the title
[Geekomatic] In the USA, when Wendy's started, they had THE best tasting burgers around.
What has happened to that quality over the decades/countries?
It won't be good. The "fast-food" co's have all traded "real food" for cheap oil and chems.
I'd love to hear from those who have tried the new AU Wendy's? What did you think?
[prankster] I’d like a in and out here in Australia but I know it won’t be as cheap as USA
[ProlapsedHeinous] From what ive heard recently its pretty expensive. But i think their practice of overloading the fries probably helps make it better value.
[ValueInvesting] McDonald's has really been going downhill with quality, prices and offers the past few years. Not just a specific store but everywhere
This is a good deal but I'd rather pay more and go to Wendy's.
[huang297] i miss when this was a regular deal in the maccas app (alongside 2x small qtr pounder/big mac meals for $8)
[Snoop] I've / we've been getting this offer in the Frankston area for the past month now.
And the best thing is, it's not a one time use.
It's even better when you add a free HJ cheeseburger thanks to the NBL.
